start: Watch Settings, Display, Text size set to normal; MettleUp watch app installed and connected to the phone

steps.action: On the watch, open Settings, Display, Text size and move it to the largest size
must_not: The MettleUp watch app crashing or closing when the text size changes

steps.action: On the phone, start a workout, tap Done on a set so the rest starts
user_sees: The watch shows the rest screen with the big countdown
must_not: The watch staying on the old screen with no countdown

steps.action: Look at the rest countdown on the watch and compare it with the same rest at the normal text size
user_sees: The countdown digits are the same height as at the normal text size
The small labels around it are a little bigger
must_not: The countdown smaller than at the normal text size (it was 23 % smaller before the fix)
The countdown cut by the round edge of the screen

tests.checks: largestTextKeepsTheCountdownSize: countdown line height at font scale 1.0 vs 1.3 within 2 px on every watch size; the scale is fed as a plain linear Density, so the Android 14 non-linear scaling that caused the bug is not reproduced

start: Watch text size at the largest; a workout running with a set waiting to be logged on the watch

steps.action: On the watch logging screen, look at the weight and reps numbers
user_sees: The weight and reps numbers at their usual size
"Set 2 of 4" and the Previous line slightly bigger, never cut
must_not: The weight or reps numbers shrunk compared with the normal text size
The Done button pushed off the round screen

steps.action: Tap a number, turn the dial, tap Done
user_sees: The number changes at full size while the dial turns
The set is logged and the rest starts
must_not: The dial tip or the numbers drawn over the Done button

tests.checks: largestText, largestTextRest, largestTextEffort, largestTextExerciseDone, largestTextLongName render at font scale 1.3 and check room above the Done/Go button; they do not compare number sizes with the normal text size

start: Watch text size at the largest; a rest running; always-on display on

steps.action: Lower the wrist so the watch goes to its dim always-on screen
user_sees: The countdown as outlined digits, the same size as on the bright screen
must_not: The outlined countdown smaller than at the normal text size
The countdown cut by the round edge

user_sees: The bright rest screen with the same countdown size
must_not: The digits jumping in size between the dim and the bright screen

tests.checks: largerText renders the rest at font scale 1.3 in both bright and ambient form as pictures only; no size assertion on the ambient form

start: Watch Settings, Display, Text size set to the SMALLEST size; a rest running

steps.action: Look at the rest countdown and the labels on the watch
user_sees: The countdown at its usual full size
The small labels at their normal size, not smaller
must_not: The countdown or the labels shrunk below the normal size

start: MettleUp open on the watch during a rest, text size at normal

steps.action: Without closing MettleUp, change Text size to the largest, come back to MettleUp
user_sees: The countdown keeps its size; the labels grow a little
must_not: The rest restarting or the countdown losing time
The old label size kept until the app is reopened

steps.action: Change Text size back to normal, come back to MettleUp
user_sees: The labels back to their normal size; the countdown unchanged
must_not: The watch app showing the larger labels after the switch back

start: Phone app, Settings, What's new, version 0.79.0

steps.action: Read the line about the watch and text size
user_sees: Your watch keeps its big numbers full size at the largest text size.
must_not: The promise failing on a watch the member owns: the countdown or weight numbers smaller at the largest text size

steps.action: Use the watch at the largest text size during a workout
user_sees: Big numbers full size; nothing about the text size setting leaves the watch
must_not: The text size setting or the workout numbers shown to the gym or anyone else

note: A long exercise name at the largest text must shrink to fit, never cut, and must not push the countdown or Done off the round screen

why_not: no time edge: the number size depends only on the text size setting and the screen width, never on the date or the time of day

note: Wrist down switches to the always-on outlined digits; they must keep the same full size
Weight in pounds gives wider numbers (5 digits); at the largest text they must still fit at full size
The feature itself; must hold on every watch size (192 to 233 dp) and on the dark always-on screen

why_not: nothing is stored: the text size is read live from the watch every time the screen is drawn, so an update has no old data to carry

note: The phone's own text size must not change the watch's number size; the watch follows only its own setting

title: The check for full-size watch numbers cannot catch the bug it was written for
what: The automatic check that the watch countdown keeps its size at the largest text feeds the text size in the simple old way, so the newer Android scaling that made the numbers 23 % smaller is never tried. The old broken code would also pass it, so a return of the bug would not be noticed before release.
expected: The check runs with the real newer Android text scaling (or a watch on Wear OS 5), so the old shrinking code would fail it.
how_often: only if the size bug comes back
fix_line: Run the size check with the real Android text scaling instead of a simple multiplier
